Ulla Davidsen is a Danish medical professional who serves as a Chief Physician (Overlæge) and MPK at Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg Hospital [^src1]. She plays a key role in the national clinical quality development for cardiovascular health in Denmark, specifically regarding the treatment, management, and data monitoring of atrial fibrillation. 

Davidsen is a member of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) [^src1]. Her continued membership in the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] is documented across consecutive annual reports, including the 2023, 2024, and 2025 editions published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute [^src2] [^src3]. Through her position on the steering committee, she contributes to the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral governance of the database, which monitors clinical practices, wait times for anticoagulation therapy, and patient outcomes to ensure uniform, evidence-based care for atrial fibrillation patients nationwide [^src2] [^src3].
